label: early first-occurrence input of c/t/j/z/k (original phase)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original-input phase (99% of mass), at steps 1-5 (peak t=3), when the input is the first occurrence of one of c, t, j, z, or k (c is strongest: 33% of mass, ~10% rate). Top activations are c at t=3-5 with earlier tokens like u, p, k, 1, x, h. It is silent at t=0, at the delimiter, and in the copy phase, and seldom fires on repeated tokens. Precision is low (about 15%): most c/t/j/z/k inputs do not cross threshold. The prefix context matters (inputs such as u/p/1/x/h/q earlier raise the rate), but that effect is diffuse and adding prefix-set conditions did not raise F1 above about 0.27.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=1 & prev_tok=k (+8.13), t=1 & prev_tok=t (+7.72), t=1 & prev_tok=z (+7.47), t=1 & prev_tok=w (+7.40), t=1 & in_tok=c (+6.78), t=1 & prev_tok=r (+6.59).
